thread:
maria: heads up — third-party MITRE engagement confirmed for next Tue 09:00 PT. Assessors want 48h evidence window and an RBAC test account. Need a short runbook and gating checklist.

alex: ack. do we have the ephemeral assessor role flow ready? I can spin a short-lived role via kms-proxy if we agree on policy.

kai: confirmed ephemeral roles via our oauth->iam bridge. I have a script to mint creds for 2h max.

devsec-bot: Assessment ticket created: SEC-4219. Evidence bucket: s3://redwood-pt-evidence/SEC-4219/

nisha: FYI — KMS alias we should use is alias/pt-assessors. Policy should be decrypt-only during the access window. Also need CloudTrail exports retained for 90 days for reviewers.

sam: propose retest acceptance gates (suggested):
- critical+high: fixed or mitigated with compensating control documented
- evidence artifacts uploaded to S3 + audit logs + proof of redaction
- RBAC diffs reviewed and PRs merged
- KMS policy snapshot saved to repo

maria: add: must have model-level telemetry (trace samples) for any inference endpoints touched. Attack-surface notes for the inference runtime required.

kai: question — how do we provide query logs without exposing PII/sensitive prompts? plan: subsample and run redaction job, keep an audit manifest.

alex: quick redact example to run on our side: 
```bash
python tools/redact_logs.py --input events.jsonl --mask-prompt=true --output s3://redwood-pt-evidence/SEC-4219/redacted/
```

nisha: KMS grant window example (for infra): grant decrypt only between 2026-03-10T16:00Z and 2026-03-10T18:00Z to principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pt-assessor. We'll snapshot key policy and commit to infra repo.

sam: another gate: automated regression evals against the provided sample prompt set must not show >15% quality degradation on key metrics. We'll require the eval job artifact uploaded as proof.

maria: can we block retest progression unless the log-exporter job has run at least once and produced a manifest? oncall?

oncall: yes — I'll schedule the exporter to run t+1h after engagement start and will post the run_id here.

devsec-bot: Evidence upload completed by @kai at 2026-03-10T16:20Z — s3://redwood-pt-evidence/SEC-4219/artifacts.tar.gz (md5: abc123)

alex: pre-retest checklist for infra/security: 
1) verify KMS key policy snapshot + ensure rotation is disabled for the window
2) RBAC diff and audit comment attached to SEC-4219
3) collate trace sample + redaction proof (manifest)
4) attach JIRA links and evidence locations to SEC-4219

maria: also need a documented mitigation decision for every vuln in the triage spreadsheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/SEC-4219-triage (will add columns: owner, fix ETA, compensating control)

sam: quick presign for assessor download if needed: 
```bash
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-pt-evidence/SEC-4219/artifacts.tar.gz --expires-in 86400
```

nisha: auditors asked for proof of no long-term KMS grant. We'll take a policy snapshot and commit to infra/kms/snapshots/SEC-4219-policy.json and include commit hash in the ticket.

kai: proposing retest window Thu-Fri same week 08:00-18:00 PT. We should freeze canary deploys and reduce autoscale during that window to avoid noisy signals.

maria: locking deployments — eng-oncall please freeze canaries 24h before the window and post the freeze.

oncall: freezing canaries Thu 07:00 PT. Will announce in #eng-releases and disable canary pipelines for the window.

sam: final operational step: when all gates pass, add a "retest-acceptance" tag to SEC-4219. I have a small verifier script that checks checksums, audit log presence, and eval results.

alex: I'll draft a one-pager for assessors with assume-role commands, presigned evidence locations, and the redaction expectations. Will drop soon.

maria: also need artifact notarization (signed manifest) so assessors can verify provenance. volunteers?

kai: I can run manifest signing with our kms-sign tool and upload manifest.json + manifest.json.sig to the s3 path.

maria: perfect — i'll open a tiny PR with the checklist items and owners. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
